title: IRELAND vs SWEDEN
subtitle: Economy size, GDP in US dollars

lines.say: In 1990, Ireland's economy was 49 billion dollars. Sweden's was 261 billion.
2025. Ireland: 722 billion. Sweden: 669. On paper, Ireland is bigger, with about half as many people.
But a large part of Ireland's GDP is the profit of international companies that book their earnings there.
That's why Ireland's own government uses a different measure for its budget. The full race is on our channel.
